title: "Tips on writing appendices"
format: html
execute:
  echo: true
navbar: false
---

Appendices allow you to include **supporting details** that are relevant to your analysis but would interrupt the flow of your main report if included there. Appendices should be concised, organized, and directly relevant to your analysis. 

In a regression report, appendices often include: 

- Technical details (diagnostics, full regression output)
- Supporting visualizations that back up your findings
- Data and variable documentation
